playstyle: Stylish counter-hit fishing that rewards mastery. Keep the opponent scared with strong mid checks and the oppressive running 3,4 (wr3,4), fish for counter hits with fast strings, and use Hitman (HMS) and Mist Step (MS). In Heat, his just-frame Cardinal moves can be done without the timing. Wavu notes his lows deal little damage.

stances.name: Hitman Stance
stances.entry: 3+4, or 3 after moves like ws4, b+4 and 1,2,4
stances.note: HMS.1,1,1 is a Heat Engager. HMS also parries some attacks.

stances.name: Mist Step
stances.entry: f~n, or F after b+2 and f,F+2
stances.note: A fast forward step; Sway is MS.b~n (Wavu).
